packageRules.description: Composer here is development tooling only; nothing it installs is shipped in the plugin. CI runs lint, static analysis, the unit suite on two PHP versions, an audit and the packaging script, so a green patch or minor can land on its own.
A major of phpcs, phpstan or phpunit changes what the gates accept. Isolated, and reviewed by a human.
The workflow's pinned actions. Three of them had already gone stale enough for GitHub to warn about a deprecated Node runtime before anyone noticed; this is the manager that would have caught it.
A major of an action can change its inputs or its runner requirements.
